Key Products/Specialties: Small-batch specialty beans roasted in Limassol since 2016
Selection Rationale: Limassol specialty roaster since 2016; also wholesales island-wide. Count once, HQ Limassol Central.

Key Products/Specialties: Loring-roasted specialty beans and farmer teas on Agiou Andreou
Selection Rationale: Downtown Limassol specialty roaster for the Central catchment's expat and office baskets.

Key Products/Specialties: Sourdough loaves, pastries and specialty coffee
Selection Rationale: Artisan sourdough is the bakery listing Limassol Central can own versus Zorbas/Sigma chains.

Key Products/Specialties: Commandaria, Xynisteri and village zivania from the Limassol hills
Selection Rationale: Short local wine and zivania set for Central; skip tourist-promenade bottles.

Key Products/Specialties: Handmade halloumi, anari, trahana and flaouna cheese from Prastio Avdimou
Selection Rationale: Small-batch west-Limassol dairy that fits this catchment better than downtown gourmet.

Key Products/Specialties: Trahana, paximadia and home-style snacks
Selection Rationale: West Limassol cooks from the pantry; range trahana and rusks, not tourist loukoumi tins.

Key Products/Specialties: Halloumi and yoghurt from the Agios Athanasios industrial plant, with a factory shop
Press Mentions: Factory in Agios Athanasios industrial area since 1997
Selection Rationale: The dairy is physically in this catchment. List factory-shop halloumi and yoghurt as the local hero.

Key Products/Specialties: Halloumi, anari, trahana and ravioli
Selection Rationale: Second Limassol family dairy for the industrial/suburban store; pair with Lefkonitziatis.

Key Products/Specialties: Nicosia's first microbrewery (2015); cold-chain craft beer
Selection Rationale: The capital craft-beer listing versus KEO. Keep cold chain; this is a takeaway brewery.

Key Products/Specialties: In-house roasted specialty coffee in Nicosia
Selection Rationale: Nicosia pioneer roaster; retail bags for the Digeni Akrita office catchment.

Key Products/Specialties: Multi-roaster cafe selling imported and Utu-branded beans
Press Mentions: Cyprus Mail Jan 2026; only multi-roaster in Cyprus
Selection Rationale: Premium bean set for central Nicosia expats and office workers.

Key Products/Specialties: Sourdough bread, pastries and specialty coffee
Press Mentions: NOMAD Nicosia branch; Hungry Games co-host
Selection Rationale: Capital sourdough listing to match Limassol NOMAD; not a chain bakery.

Key Products/Specialties: Pitsilia wines and zivania sold in Nicosia retail
Selection Rationale: Mountain winery/zivania for the capital store; short local set, not a full imported aisle.

Key Products/Specialties: Easter flaouna cheese, trahana and rusks
Selection Rationale: Dali cooks Cypriot; range pantry heroes, not Paphos loukoumi gift tins.

Key Products/Specialties: Sea bream, red mullet, octopus, squid and cuttlefish landed at Zygi
Press Mentions: Best-known Cyprus fish landing between Limassol and Larnaca
Selection Rationale: Larnaca is the natural grocery home for Zygi fish; sealed fresh/frozen beats sending people to the village.

Key Products/Specialties: PDO halloumi including sheep-and-goat packs, from Skarinou-Larnaca
Selection Rationale: District dairy for Larnaca Central; better local story than only island-wide brands.

Key Products/Specialties: Craft beer, lager and cider from Tsada, 15 minutes from Paphos old town
Press Mentions: Cyprus' first licensed microbrewery; CAMRA / TripAdvisor Paphos
Selection Rationale: The Paphos craft-beer listing. Cans for holiday homes and old-town delivery.

Key Products/Specialties: Paphos specialty coffee
Press Mentions: Cyprus Mail: at least one specialty shop (BeanHaus) in Paphos
Selection Rationale: Paphos roast-at-home bags for British holiday homes and old-town cafes.

Key Products/Specialties: Loukoumi Geroskipou PGI, paphitiki pissa and traditional sweets since 1895
Press Mentions: First Cypriot product with PGI; family business in Geroskipou
Selection Rationale: PGI loukoumi belongs in the Paphos store as grocery, not only a tourist-shop tin.

Key Products/Specialties: Paphos-district wines from Kathikas
Selection Rationale: Local wine for Paphos holiday homes; Xynisteri and village reds, not only imported supermarket wine.

Key Products/Specialties: Fresh fish for the free Famagusta coast
Selection Rationale: Summer seafood demand around Ayia Napa/Protaras; quieter winter ranging.
